Greenville County is the core of South Carolina's Upstate, built around downtown Greenville's revitalized Main Street and Unity Park district and ringed by fast-growing suburbs like Simpsonville and Greer near GSP International Airport. It sits at the edge of the BMW-anchored manufacturing corridor centered in neighboring Spartanburg County, and steady corporate relocation keeps both urban infill and suburban greenfield land active.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: September 27, 2026
